description: Pistas de aeroporto - Escala 1:250.000 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Plano de informação referente as pistas de aeroporto em escala 100.000 com recorte espacial para as cartas topográficas que recobrem o Estado do Tocantins. Dado geoespacial vetorial de referência da Base Cartográfica Digital Contínua do Estado do Tocantins. Integra a Base de Dados Geográficos do Estado do Tocantins. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Pista de aeroporto e aeródromo, Sistema de transporte, Base de Dados Geográficos do Tocantins, Base Cartográfica Digital Contínua do Estado do Tocantins, Estado do Tocantins. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
